stories.title: Daughter accused in ₹1.20 crore robbery breaks down in jail:Sister told her brother she felt suffocated in prison; boyfriend had allegedly planned the robbery
stories.summary: A 21-year-old woman arrested for helping her boyfriend plan a robbery at her businessman father’s house in Moradabad is now crying continuously inside jail and regretting her actions. Police said the accused, Ariba, breaks down almost every night and keeps asking to return home. Ariba was arrested for allegedly helping in the robbery of ₹1.20 crore cash and 6 tola gold from her father’s house. According to jail officials, she is eating very little food and spends most of her time weeping. Female guards and other inmates try to calm her, but she starts crying again after some time. Officials said Ariba repeatedly tells jail staff that she wants to meet her parents and go back home. She also says she is unable to live peacefully inside the jail. During a recent jail visit, Ariba hugged her brother and started crying. She told him that she had made a very big mistake and begged him to somehow take her home. She also asked her family to forgive her and said she feels suffocated inside the jail. Sources said her family has now started trying for her bail, but legal experts believe it may not be easy because of the serious nature of the case. Jail officials said Ariba was extremely disturbed when she was brought to jail on Thursday and cried throughout the night. Officials added that because of her mental condition, she is being kept under close watch inside the jail. Even during the following nights, she reportedly continued crying at intervals and remained awake for most of the night after sleeping briefly during the day. Ariba told the female inmates - My family will not get me out. Jail officials said that there are a total of 78 female inmates in the women's barracks in the jail. Ariba is also trying to mingle among them. The female inmates explain to Ariba that don't worry, your bail will be granted soon and you will be released from here. However, Ariba starts crying even at this reassurance. She says - I betrayed my family. I betrayed my mom-dad and brothers. That's why they probably won't get me out of here. They will never forgive me. However, after her brother visited her in jail, Ariba has gained hope that her family will help her. Her brother told Ariba that efforts are being made to get her bail. Since then, Ariba is trying to be somewhat normal. Ariba was the most beloved child of her parents Ariba was the most beloved child in her family. Her father, brass businessman Imran, and mother Seema loved Ariba very much. Her other daughter Aliza did not have as much freedom as Ariba did. Both brothers, Arib and Arkan, also doted on their sister. The family never even dreamt that their most beloved daughter could commit such an act. 8-year affair, family was not ready for marriage On May 11, at 3:40 AM, a robbery of 1.20 crore cash and 6 tola gold occurred at the house of a brass businessman in the Akbar Compound area, Nagphani police station. The police revealed this on May 14. The robbery was plotted by the businessman's daughter, Ariba, along with her boyfriend. Their affair had been going on for 8 years. Both wanted to get married, but the businessman and his family were not ready for it. After this, both conspired together. The boyfriend's 7 friends supported him. All of them are pursuing B. Pharma from the same college. 6 miscreants entered the house, took the businessman and son at gunpoint In Moradabad, brass businessman Imran lives with his family in the Akbar Compound area, within the Nagphani police station jurisdiction. His family includes his wife Seema and 4 children: Arib (26), Arkan (23), Ariba (21), and Aliza (19). On May 11, at 3:40 AM, Imran's house was robbed of 1.20 crore cash and 6 tolas of jewellery. 6 miscreants entered the house and committed the crime by holding a pistol to the temples of the businessman and his son, Arib. Within minutes, the miscreants fled the scene in two cars after looting the cash and jewellery. Imran's house has a digital lock. The miscreants neither broke the digital lock nor entered the house through any other route. Not even a sound of them entering the house was heard. Additionally, the miscreants also had precise information about the 1.2 crore rupees cash kept in the house. As soon as they arrived, they questioned the brass businessman about the cash. In such a situation, it was suspected that a member of the household was involved with the miscreants. Ariba's Mobile Details and CCTV Revealed the Secret Just two days after the incident, on Thursday, May 14, the police arrested Ariba, the daughter of a brass businessman, her boyfriend Arshad Warsi, and her 3 other associates, thereby exposing the crime. 47 lakh rupees from the looted amount, 2 cars used in the crime, and 4 country-made pistols were also recovered. SSP Satpal Antil said- Since the incident, the police were engaged in investigating the case. With the help of CCTV footage and electronic surveillance, the police reached the businessman's daughter Ariba and arrested her. During interrogation, she provided information about all the criminals involved in the robbery. She also stated that she herself had opened the digital locks installed in the house by pressing the buzzer button located on the first floor of the house, near her bedroom. Police arrested Ariba, her boyfriend Arshad Warsi, and three other accused: Kuldeep (26), Ravi (26), and Nikki (2). All the accused are studying B-Pharma at the Institute of Foreign Trade and Management (IFTM University), Moradabad. Meanwhile, Ariba has studied up to 12th grade. She stays at home. Used to give sleeping pills to family members Ariba had an affair with Arshad Warsi, a resident of Amroha, for about 7-8 years. Both had sworn to live and die together. But, due to different castes, Ariba's family was not ready for this marriage. However, Ariba had made up her mind that she wanted to live with Arshad Warsi. Ariba used to meet her lover constantly. When her family stopped her from meeting him, she often gave sleeping pills to her family, put them into a deep sleep, and met Arshad. She also used to call him home. The entire planning was Ariba's, she gave the main gate key to her boyfriend During police interrogation, Ariba revealed - According to the plan, about a month ago, I got a key made for the main gate. I gave this key to Arshad. I told Arshad that he would open the main gate with this key and come inside the house. After this, I would open the second digital lock of the house by pressing the button inside the house. Then Arshad would easily enter the house with his companions. Before going to jail, when Ariba was asked if the entire planning of this incident was hers, she nodded her head in affirmation.

stories.title: Yogi cabinet clears backward commission for Panchayat polls:Allowance of veterinary doctors increased by ₹8,000 and Lucknow Metro expansion also approved
stories.summary: For the first time after the cabinet expansion, a meeting was held on Monday under the chairmanship of CM Yogi in Lucknow. In this, 12 proposals were approved, including the expansion of Lucknow Metro. The formation of an OBC commission for conducting Panchayat elections has been approved. The High Court had ordered the formation of the commission. Panchayat elections will be held in the state only after the commission's report. In addition, the internship allowance for students studying veterinary medicine has been increased from 8 thousand to 12 thousand rupees. Earlier, they used to get 4 thousand rupees every month. About 2,000 to 2,500 students get admission every year in BVSc AH (Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry) in the colleges of the state. Including all batches, more than 10 thousand veterinary students are studying in UP.

stories.title: Premanand Maharaj health deteriorates, padyatra suspended:Private Darshan stopped for an indefinite period; disciples request devotees to return
stories.summary: The health of Saint Premanand Maharaj has worsened, due to which his night pilgrimage has been postponed indefinitely. His private darshan has also been suspended for now. On Sunday night, thousands of devotees reached for his darshan. However, Premanandji did not begin the pilgrimage at 3 AM as he usually does. Instead, his disciples arrived in his place and informed devotees about the change. The disciples announced via loudspeaker: We request everyone that due to Maharajji's ill health, the pilgrimage is being canceled from today. Please do not gather by standing on the roadside. After this, devotees had to return disappointed without having Maharajji's darshan. According to Kelly Kunj Ashram, Maharajji has been suffering from kidney problems for 21 years. See 2 pictures- Devotees said - We pray to Radha that Maharajji gets well soon. Maharaj walks one and a half km Saint Premanand Maharaj these days leaves Kelly Kunj Ashram for Saubhari Van at 3 AM. He walks 1.5 km. Thousands of devotees arrive to have darshan of Premanand Maharaj. On normal days, this number is around 20,000. On weekends and major festivals, the number of devotees coming for darshan increases manifold, reaching into lakhs. Now, the story of Saint Premanand Maharaj Left home at the age of 13 Premanand Maharaj was born in Akhri village, Narwal tehsil, Kanpur district, Uttar Pradesh. His father is Shambhu Narayan Pandey and his mother is Rama Devi. He has 3 brothers, Premanand is the middle one. In childhood, Premanand ji's name was Anirudh Kumar Pandey. He was spiritual from childhood. He studied up to class 8. In his childhood, Anirudh wanted to build a platform for a Shiva temple with his group of friends. He also started its construction, but some people stopped it. This made him sad. His heart was so broken that he decided to leave home. He reached Kashi via Kanpur. When he turned 13, he decided to become a celibate (Brahmachari). Initially, Premanand Maharaj's name was 'Aryan Brahmachari'. He spent about 15 months in Kashi. He received initiation (Gurudiksha) from Guru Gauri Sharan Ji Maharaj. Then he came to Mathura. Premanand Maharaj transformed from a Sanyasi to a Radhavallabhi Saint Upon reaching Vrindavan, Premanand Maharaj would visit Banke Bihari Ji every day. Then he became fond of Rasleela and started attending Radhavallabh programs. He would stand there for hours. One day, a saint recited a verse from Shri Radharasudhanidhi, but Maharaj could not understand it. Then one day, while circumambulating Vrindavan, he heard a Sakhi singing a verse. Hearing her, the king paused. The verse pleased him so much that he broke his ascetic vows and went to that friend (sakh?). He asked her for the meaning of the verse. The friend said, "To understand its meaning, one must be a Radhavallabhi." Thus, the king became a Radhavallabhi.

stories.title: ‘Kyu Mangey Udhaar Jab Apna Neta Taiyaar’:Chirag's posters spark buzz in UP, Bihar parties to contest polls; tough test ahead for Sanjay Nishad
stories.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Chirag Paswan’s Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) has started showing its strength in Lucknow through new posters and political messages. The posters carry the slogan, “Why should leaders ask for loans, when our own leader is ready.” In the posters, Chirag Paswan is seen standing with folded hands. Pictures of several senior party leaders have also been included. The move is being seen as the party’s effort to increase its presence in Uttar Pradesh politics. Party MP and senior leader Arun Bharti told Dainik Bhaskar that the party’s focus is not only on Bihar but also on Uttar Pradesh. He said the party is preparing to contest all 403 seats in the 2027 Assembly elections. At the same time, Mukesh Sahani, who is known for raising issues related to the Nishad community, is also preparing for elections in eastern Uttar Pradesh. He is expected to field candidates on seats where the Nishad community has a strong presence. Read a special report on the entry of Bihar's parties into UP politics The discussion of Bihar's parties in UP politics started after 2 incidents- First- when posters of Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) were put up in Lucknow, outside the CM's residence, near the Assembly, at Atal Chowk and Hazratganj. In these, Chirag Paswan is standing with folded hands. Behind him is a crowd of people. The poster also features pictures of prominent leaders associated with the party. Second- Mukesh Sahani, who does Nishad community politics in Bihar, is strengthening his roots by holding VIP worker conferences in the districts of Purvanchal. He asks if Nishads received reservation? If not, why doesn't Sanjay Nishad resign from BJP? First, let's talk about Chirag Paswan's Lok Janshakti Party's preparations to contest elections in UP. Regarding this, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to LJP (R)'s number-2 and Jamui MP Arun Bharti Question- Chirag Paswan's posters have been put up in Lucknow, what does this mean? Answer- The party's entire focus is on UP. We are working on organisational expansion in UP. The party will be strengthened at the booth level. Large-scale programs will be held across the state. Question- What will be at the center of politics? Answer- The party will raise the voice of Dalits, the deprived, and weaker sections. Question- Will you contest elections in UP? Will you also form an alliance? Answer- Currently, we do not have any alliance with anyone in UP. We are going to contest elections on all 403 seats. Question- You have an alliance with BJP at the center. Will this not happen in UP? Answer- LJP has an alliance with BJP at the center, not at the UP level. However, seat-sharing talks with NDA could happen at the last minute. We will see that later. Chirag Paswan's party is a kingmaker in Bihar Chirag Paswan's party is quite strong in Bihar. He himself is the Food Processing Minister in the central government. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Chirag Paswan's party got 5 seats in Bihar from the NDA alliance. Chirag's party won all seats with a 100% strike rate. Chirag himself won from Hajipur and Arun Bharti won from Jamui. This proved that Bihar's 'Paswan/Dusadh' vote bank is completely with Chirag. This constitutes 5-6% of the total vote bank. In the Bihar Assembly elections held in November 2025, LJP (R)'s performance was also excellent. The party won 19 out of the 29 seats allotted by the NDA alliance. Today, Chirag's party has become the third-largest force in Bihar after JDU-BJP. 'Chirag' will target many districts of UP The total Scheduled Caste (SC) population in UP is approximately 21%. This is about 4.13 crore. The largest share, about 54-56%, belongs to the Jatav/Chamar community. The second largest share, about 16%, belongs to the Pasi community. In addition, castes like Dhobi, Kori, Valmiki, and Dhanuk are also included. Chirag Paswan's party LJP (R) will make these its base for politics. LJP (R)'s main focus is on Purvanchal and districts bordering Bihar, where the population of Dalits (especially Pasi and non-Jatav communities) and backward classes is high. Is this a game to form a National Party or an expansion of the organisation? Chirag Paswan does not want to limit his party only to Bihar. He wants to get it the status of a National Party. This is why he is becoming active in other states as well. Besides UP, his party has also contested elections in Jharkhand, Jammu and Kashmir, and Nagaland. According to the Election Commission, for any party to become a National Party, it must fulfill one of these conditions. In UP politics, Dalit (SC) and Nishad (OBC) vote banks have always been game-changers. In such a situation, the arrival of Chirag Paswan and Mukesh Sahani can change the equations of the state. Chirag Paswan will focus on Dalit (especially Paswan) voters. He will also benefit from his youth image. This could potentially dent BSP's traditional Dalit vote. Meanwhile, Mukesh Sahani's VIP party advocates for the rights of Nishad, Mallah, Kashyap, and Bind communities. In UP, Sanjay Nishad leads the politics of the Nishad-Mallah community. He is currently a cabinet minister in the Yogi government. In the 2022 elections, Nishad Party contested more than 11 seats in alliance with BJP. It won 6 seats directly on its symbol (food plate). These seats include Majhwan of Mirzapur, Gyanpur of Bhadohi, Katehari of Ambedkar Nagar and Tumkuhi Raj of Kushinagar. Now VIP can also be seen on these seats against Sanjay Nishad. Because, Sanjay Nishad will contest the elections in alliance with BJP. In such a situation, it is believed that the Samajwadi Party can support Bihar's VIP party.

stories.title: Obsessed lover turns out to be killer of Meerut student:Girl went to give exam before attack; mobile message pleaded ‘please save me God’
stories.summary: A 20-year-old student was murdered in Meerut, allegedly by an obsessed lover and his friends. Police arrested the main accused late on Sunday night. During questioning, he admitted that he had been friends with the student for the past three years. He told police that he became angry after seeing her talking to another boy, which led to an argument. Later, he and his friends allegedly killed her. According to police, the student had left home on May 15 to appear for her BA third-year examination, but did not return by evening. Her family searched for her and later filed a missing person complaint at the police station the same day. On May 17, the student’s decomposed body was found in a sugarcane field nearly 25 km away from her home. After the body was recovered, angry family members protested outside the police station. They accused the accused of gang rape and murder. Police assured the family that strict action would be taken and registered a case against three youths based on the complaint. Late Sunday night, police arrested the main accused, Ankush, from his house, while two other accused are still absconding. Police also recovered a note from the student’s mobile phone which read, “Please save me God,” indicating that she may have been in fear before her death. The case is related to the TP Nagar police station area in Meerut. A note was found in the girl's mobile, read what it says... Today, on 11/05/26, I am going to take the exam, but I am feeling very strange. I don't know why, but I have this feeling deep inside. God, I beg you with folded hands, please don't let anything go wrong. Please, please, please God, my home will fall apart. God, I implore you, please keep everything alright. My mother, father, and siblings won't be able to live without me. They feel lost without me, I don't know why, even as I write this, my tears are flowing. Read the full case chronologically The father of the student, who resides in Meerut's TP Nagar police station area, is a tailor. The family includes the student's mother, sister, and younger brother. On May 15, the student had gone to a degree college to take the Political Science exam, but did not return home until late evening. The family members called her friends. They inquired at the college, but the girl could not be found. After this, the family filed a missing person report at the TP Nagar police station late in the evening. Police started searching for the girl. On Sunday, May 17, the girl's body was found in a sugarcane field in Ukasia village, under the Rohta police station area. A young man from the village saw the body. After this, the police were called. The student's face had been eaten by insects. It also seemed as if an attempt had been made to burn the body with acid after the murder. However, no signs of struggle were found at the crime scene. In such a situation, the police suspected that the girl was murdered elsewhere and then her body was dumped here. Police called the family members and identified the body. Seeing the body, the family members created a ruckus at the police station. The student's father alleged that if the TP Nagar police had listened in time, his daughter's life would have been saved. He accused three boys of gang-raping and murdering his daughter. Police assured the family members of action against the three. Following this, a case was registered against the deranged Ankush and his two friends Nishant and Ankit, based on the family's complaint. SSP Avinash Pandey said- When the police started the investigation, the girl was seen leaving in CCTV footage. Based on the family's suspicion and evidence, Ankush's name came forward. Five police teams were formed. Ankush was taken into custody. During interrogation, he confessed to the murder. The remaining two accused will also be apprehended as soon as possible.The picture is from the post-mortem house. The police had taken information about the incident from the family.The madman had been harassing the daughter for 2 years, now he has killed her.The father said - Accused Ankush had been harassing his daughter for a long time. He used to follow her. 2 years ago, Ankush tried to kidnap the daughter. The daughter had told us about this. After this, a panchayat was held. Then Ankush apologized in front of everyone, but later started harassing the daughter again. Fed up with his actions, we left the village 6 months ago. We started living in a rented room on Rohta Road in Meerut, but he did not stop following the daughter. Now he has killed the daughter.Chandrashekhar Azad said - Government should provide assistance to the victim's familyOn the matter,Azad Samaj Party chief Chandrashekhar Azad wrote on X - The government should provide assistance to the victim's family and arrest the accused.

stories.title: Deadly road crash in Uttar Pradesh claims 10 lives:Teacher and engineer among victims; truck hit van carrying several passengers
stories.summary: Ten people were killed after a Magic vehicle collided with a truck at around 7.30 am on Monday in Lakhimpur Kheri. All the victims were travelling in the Magic vehicle. Nine people died on the spot, while one later died in hospital. The dead included a government school teacher and an engineer. The accident happened near Adlispur village on the Pilibhit-Basti Highway, around 40km from the district headquarters. Eyewitnesses said the Magic vehicle was travelling from Lakhimpur towards Sisaiya when it was hit head-on by a speeding truck coming from Bahraich. The truck driver fled from the scene after the crash. The collision was so severe that several passengers suffered fatal head injuries and became trapped between the seats. Two people were thrown out onto the road. Local residents informed the police, who later sent the bodies for post-mortem examination. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over the accident and announced financial assistance of ₹2 lakh each for the families of the deceased. Truck seized, driver absconding Khamaria Circle Officer Shamsher Bahadur Singh said the truck (UP 14 HT 5176) is registered in the name of Sher Singh, a resident of Nagla Faridpur in Bareilly. He is the second owner of the truck. The vehicle carried a Ghaziabad number plate and was loaded with sacks of rice polish. Police have seized the truck and launched a search for the driver. CHC Khamaria superintendent Dr Amit Kumar Singh said the bodies of two women and seven men were brought to the hospital after the accident. Several bodies were badly crushed. One seriously injured man was referred to the district hospital, but he died on the way. Village head blames overtaking attempt Eyewitness and village head of Naya Gaon, Pradeep Verma, said the condition of the Magic vehicle suggested the driver may have been trying to overtake another vehicle when it collided with the speeding truck coming from the opposite direction. He said nine passengers died inside the vehicle immediately after the crash, while one young man was still alive and struggling. Locals broke open the gate of the vehicle to pull him out and sent him to the hospital in an ambulance, but he later died. Nine victims identified, one yet to be identified Police said nine of the ten victims have been identified so far. The deceased included two brothers, Pawan (23) and Sohan (21), residents of Moorteeha village in Bahraich. Adnan (15), a resident of Sisaiya village in the Dhaurahara area of Kheri district, also died in the crash. Other victims included Pappu (18) from Devdattpur in Bahraich, Shahzad (35) from Kakraha Moorteeha in Bahraich, and Julekha (55) from Dhaurahara in Kheri district. The identity of one victim is still being confirmed. Government teacher, engineer and businessman among the dead Gayatri, 44, was a resident of Vijay Lakshmi Nagar in Sitapur and worked as a government teacher at a primary school in Mihimpurwa, Bahraich. She had left home in the morning to go to school. Jaiveer Singh, 25, from Man Gothiya village in Bahraich, worked as an engineer in a power company in Mumbai. He had resigned from his job on 16 May after securing a new job in Qatar. Rajesh Goyal, 54, from Mihimpurwa in Bahraich, ran a business supplying ghee, oil and sugar. He had come to Lakhimpur to visit his brother-in-law, Pawan Singhal and was returning to Bahraich when the accident happened. Engineer was preparing to leave for Qatar Jaiveer Singh’s father, Peshkar Singh, is a retired Home Guard officer. His uncle Jitendra said Jaiveer had resigned from his Mumbai company on 16 May because he had received a new job offer in Qatar. He was scheduled to fly from Pune to Qatar on 21 May and was returning home to meet his family before leaving. His younger brother Prakash Singh said Jaiveer was the only earning member of the family. “This accident has taken away our only support,” he said.

stories.title: US fitness influencer amazed by Brij Bhushan’s lavish estate:Explored a Helicopter, rode ₹2.5 crore horse; later fired 2 rounds from a rifle
stories.summary: American fitness icon and social media influencer Ashton Hall reached Gonda for a two-day visit. During the visit, he met former BJP MP Brijbhushan Singh and his MP son Karan Bhushan Singh. Ashton Hall was surprised after seeing Brijbhushan Singh’s 15-acre mansion and his helicopter. On Sunday morning, around 8 AM, Karan Bhushan took Ashton Hall to the Nandini Nagar Shooting Range. There, Ashton Hall showed interest in shooting. Karan Bhushan gave him a rifle and explained some shooting tips. Ashton Hall then fired two shots. Called Karan Bhushan 'Boss' Ashton noticed the 'B' written on Karan Bhushan's slippers. In a lighthearted manner, Ashton said 'B' meant 'Boss'. People started laughing at this. Ashton Hall exercised in the gym by lifting Brijbhushan's Hanuman Gada. Ashton could not lift the Hanuman Gada in the initial 2 attempts. He succeeded in the third attempt. Ashton also played cricket with children. He chanted 'Khelo India' and 'Bharat Mata ki Jai' slogans. He rode horses worth two and a half crore. Ashton has 18 million followers on Instagram. See pictures Ashton Hall also visited Brijbhushan Singh's stable. Ashton Hall on India Visit American influencer Ashton Hall is currently on a visit to India. He is meeting personalities associated with various sports and cultural activities in India. He is capturing these experiences on his camera and sharing them on social media. On Sunday morning, Ashton Hall reached the Nandini Nagar Shooting Range. Here, MP Karan Bhushan Singh welcomed him. He was taken to the shooting range and taught shooting. After this, MP Karan Bhushan took him to his house. Here he was shown the helicopter, house, and stable. Ashton Hall also enjoyed horse riding. Ashton Hall got excited seeing the mace Karan showed his father Brijbhushan Sharan Singh's gym. Ashton Hall was very happy to see the Hanuman mace kept there. He started exercising by lifting the mace. Ashton Hall and Yogendra Kushwaha highly praised Karan Bhushan Singh for this entire meeting. Both expressed their happiness by coming to Gonda and gaining experience in shooting. Ashton Hall is unmatched in terms of fitness MP Karan Bhushan Singh said, Ashton Hall is unmatched in terms of fitness. People keep learning something or the other from him. Upon his arrival in Gonda, I welcomed him. Taught him shooting. Arranged horse riding. Also showed him my home. After this, Ashton Hall departed with his team. Met the wrestlers undergoing training Brijbhushan Sharan Singh took Ashton Hall to the Wrestling Training Centre of the Indian Wrestling Federation. There, he met the wrestlers who were training. He took pictures with them. Ashton Hall gave fitness tips to the children. Motivated them to train diligently Brijbhushan Sharan Singh and Ashton Hall gave wrestling kits to several wrestlers. They motivated them to train diligently. Later, Ashton Hall played cricket with the children on the grounds of Nandini Nagar Mahavidyalaya. Brijbhushan Sharan Singh said that the guest from America has been welcomed. He met the children learning wrestling, distributed kits, and later departed to see his (the guest's) house, helicopter, and horses. He said, local children and people also warmly welcomed Ashton Hall.

stories.title: Severe heatwave grips 33 districts across UP:IMD advises people to stay indoors; CM Yogi asks officials to monitor situation on ground
stories.summary: The heat in Uttar Pradesh is increasing day by day, with many districts, including Bundelkhand, facing severe heatwave conditions. Strong sunlight was seen across almost all districts since Monday morning, while slow wind movement increased humidity and discomfort among people. The India Meteorological Department has issued a heatwave alert for 33 districts today. IMD says that people should remain alert. Do not step out of the house during the afternoon. Take special care of the elderly, children, and sick people. Drink as much water as possible and wear light cotton clothes. CM Yogi has also instructed all District Magistrates, the Health Department, the Electricity Department, and relief agencies to remain in alert mode. He also asked to keep ambulance services active. The CM has instructed officials to go into the field, keep special vigil on sensitive districts, and complete relief and rescue preparations in a timely manner. Arrangements have been asked to be made for the treatment of patients affected by heatstroke in government hospitals. Instructions have also been given to ensure the arrangement of drinking water in public places and an uninterrupted power supply. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda was the hottest city in the country. The temperature here was recorded at 46.4 °C. Out of the 24 hottest cities in the country, 4 districts of UP were included. Besides Banda, this includes Jhansi (44.6 °C), Prayagraj (44.5 °C), and Hamirpur (44.2 °C). Water was sprinkled on the roads in Kanpur. Coolers were installed in stables in Prayagraj. The elephant was repeatedly bathed at Gorakhpur Zoo.

stories.title: Beheaded body of young woman recovered from train in Lucknow:Police found torso in a box and body parts in a bag; head still missing
stories.summary: On Sunday, a headless body of a young woman was found on the Gomtinagar Express, which travels from Chhapra, Bihar to Lucknow. The body, found in a sleeper coach, was enclosed in a box. The young woman's hands and feet were packed in polythene. The head has not yet been found. Upon receiving information, GRP and RPF arrived at the scene. GRP has registered a case and started an investigation. The case pertains to coach S-1 of train number 15114 at Gomtinagar station. See 2 pictures Now the sequence of events in detail Train number 15114 runs between Chhapra and Gomtinagar. The train departed from Chhapra at 5:45 PM on May 16 and reached Gomtinagar Railway Station at 6 AM on Sunday. During cleaning in coach S-1, staff found a suspicious bag and box. The staff informed the station superintendent about this. After this, GRP and RPF were called. GRP in-charge of Charbagh, Dharamveer Singh, said that upon reaching the spot with the team, the box was opened. It contained the torso of a young woman, aged around 30-35 years. Neither the head has been found yet, nor has the identity of the young woman been established. Her hands and feet were found packed in a polythene bag. The body has been sent for post-mortem. The young woman was wearing a colourful suit The young woman found in the box was wearing a colourful suit. Seeing this, it is suspected that the young woman might be from a village. At first glance, it appears that the young woman was cut with a sharp weapon. It is suspected that the killer might have used a cleaver, typically used in slaughterhouses. However, no signs of struggle or injury were found on the young woman's body. Meanwhile, the body was packed in the box in such a way that the bloodstains remained inside and were not visible outside. The hands and feet were also in polythene, and no blood was visible from that either. Team formed for identification, passengers to be questioned A team has been formed for the identification of the young woman's body, which will investigate by questioning passengers in the bogie and also from stations along the route. In fact, the Chhapra-Gomtinagar Express train passes through a total of 20 stations. This train completes its journey in about 12 hours. In such a situation, GRP will check the CCTV of all stations on the route. Those who boarded the bogie with boxes will be investigated using CCTV. Details of passengers traveling in S-1 bogie with reservations will be taken and they will be interrogated.

stories.title: Banda becomes country’s hottest district:57,000 tonnes of sand extracted daily from Ken River; 25% hills already lost
stories.summary: Banda has once again recorded extreme heat. On May 16, the district became the hottest place in Uttar Pradesh with the temperature touching 44.8°C. Earlier, on April 27, Banda was also recorded as the hottest district in the country when the mercury reached 47.6°C. Experts say this is not happening suddenly, but is linked to the fast destruction of natural resources in the area. According to experts, Banda’s environment is getting damaged every year. In the last 10 years, nearly 20% to 25% of the hills in the district have either disappeared or more than half of them have been broken. At the same time, around 2,000 trucks of sand are being taken out daily from the Ken River. This is equal to nearly 57,000 tonnes of sand every day. A study published in the science magazine ‘Journal of Extension Systems’ claims that 13.72% of Banda’s forest area is being cut every year. However, new trees are not being planted in the same numbers. Experts warn that if natural resources continue to be destroyed at this speed, Banda could turn barren in the next 20 to 25 years. To understand the ground situation, we visited Kewatra village, which is around 6 km from Banda city. The route passes through Babulal Chauraha and Padmakar Chauraha. The Ken River flows near the village. Our team parked the car 100 meters away. After this, we walked to the riverbank. Here, people were extracting sand from the river while sitting in boats. Some people were coming to the riverbank with sand. After this, the sand was being loaded into mini dumpers and taken towards the top of the riverbank. Now, whether this work is happening with government permission or illegally, no one there was found to tell. Mountains are slowly being destroyed, there is also fear of mafia here After witnessing the plight of the Ken River in Kewatra village, we reached Girwa village, 35 km away. This road passes through Babulal Chauraha and Atarra Chungi. Blasting was being done in the hills here. A plant for breaking stones to make gravel was also visible. Meanwhile, the laborers working there also told us about the mining mafia. Hearing this, our team parked the bike there, as a slight mistake could have been fatal. Walking about 500 meters, we reached the spot where the mountain was being broken. Here, blasting was being done by placing explosives in the hills. Crusher machines were installed at some distance. With their help, stones were being broken to make gravel. We captured all this on our camera. Ken River is being riddled with holes in Rajghat Leaving Girwa, we reached Rajghat directly. The distance between the two is about 42 Km. This route passes through Atarra Chungi, Chhoti Bazaar, and Khutla Rahuniya. People said that Rajghat is surrounded by bushes. It is also quite narrow. Therefore, mining activities here go unnoticed by people. Dainik Bhaskar's team walked along the river bank and reached the Duredi mine. Here, Poclain machines were extracting sand (maurung) from the river. These machines were blocking the river's flow to extract sand. After that, the sand was being loaded into trucks and dumpers. According to the rules of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) and the Mining Department, extracting sand from the riverbed using Poclain or heavy machinery is banned. Abhishek Shukla, a journalist from Banda, states - In Girwa, Patraha, and Jarar villages of Naraini tehsil, 16 companies are breaking mountains. An equal number of companies are producing gravel. Mining mafias are drilling 2 to 4 inches instead of the prescribed 1 inch for blasting. Dust and smoke spread like a blanket in the air. They prevent the earth's heat from rising. These dust particles also settle on plants and the ground. This causes the soil's moisture to disappear. Ken River drying up due to sand mining Umashankar Pandey, who received the Padma Shri for water conservation in Banda, explains - The Ken River originates from Satna (Madhya Pradesh). It is a total of 427 km long. Sand mining takes place in about 100 km of the stretch that flows through Banda. Mining mafias do not follow the rules of the Environment Department and the Mining Department. Extracting sand from rivers with excavators (Poclain) is prohibited, but it is happening rampantly. Sand mining also removes sand. The land becomes stony. This causes water to flow away instead of staying. Cutting of trees is also increasing the heat Millions of trees were cut down to build the Bundelkhand Expressway, which started in 2022. The UP Forest Department stated in an RTI in December 2020 that a total of 1 lakh 89 thousand 36 trees were cut for the Bundelkhand Expressway. Thousands of trees were also cut in Banda, which was part of this project. A study was conducted in 2025 regarding Banda's forest area. It revealed that Banda's total forest area decreased by 15.54%. Meanwhile, dense forests saw a reduction of 17.55%. This study was published on ResearchGate by researchers from Banda Agriculture University, Bareilly's Ruhelkhand University, Lucknow University, and Varanasi's BHU. ResearchGate is a social networking platform created for scientists and students involved in research.

stories.title: ‘Darling, I leaked two papers for you, come and meet’:Lucknow University professor accused of pressuring student and harassment
stories.summary: A BSc final year student of Lucknow University has accused an Assistant Professor of harassment and paper leak pressure. The student alleged that Assistant Professor Dr Paramjit Singh called her during leave and asked her to return before the exam, claiming that the question paper had already been leaked for her. During the phone call, the professor allegedly told the student, “Darling, I’ve leaked the paper for you. Come back from home before the exam. We will give you the paper here.” He also asked about her mother’s health and repeatedly pressured her to return early from leave. At first, the student refused to come back, but later agreed during the conversation. However, after the call ended, she was heard in the audio saying that she did not want the leaked paper and feared being harassed again. The matter has now reached the university administration, which has taken it seriously. An inquiry has been started against the Assistant Professor. The university has also approached the police to register a case, and the student’s statement will be recorded as part of the investigation. Claim of both Main Subject and Elective papers being leaked The accused professor is from the Zoology Department. On a phone call, he claimed to the student that both the core or main subject and elective (optional subject) papers had been leaked. During the conversation, the accused professor can also be heard pressuring the student to meet before the exam. However, the student can be heard continuously refusing to meet. Now read the conversation happening in the audio Professor- Child, is mom okay? Student- Yes sir. Everything is fine. Professor- Okay, good, let me know if you need any help. Most doctors at KGMU and PGI are known to me. Alright darling if you say so, I'll come myself. Let me know if you need any financial support too. Everything is open for you. Student- No sir, there's no such problem. Everything will be done. I also need to look after things at home right now. Professor- No, I'll tell you which day we should meet? I have gotten both the core and elective papers ready for you. Student- No sir, I have already studied. My syllabus is complete. Professor- Oh man, I have gotten the entire paper ready for you. Just come. Student- I have already studied, sir. Professor- So, won't you come to meet me once? Student- Sir, I need to look after mom a bit. Because of this, staying at home is important. Professor- So tell me, by when will you come to meet me once? Student- Sir, let me settle down a bit at home. Professor- So, within seven days? Student- Sir, I'll come after the exams are over. Professor- Come to meet me, I've leaked both papers for you. Student- Okay, I'll try. I'll see at home, I'll come whenever I can manage to leave. Professor- Not 'try', you absolutely have to come. Okay, come within 4 days. Student- Yes sir Professor- Okay, okay After this, the conversation between the professor and the student stops. Then the student is heard saying- So this man is calling me. I will not go. I don't want the papers. He is calling me to his office so he can molest me again. University spokesperson said - strict action will be taken University spokesperson Prof. Mukul Srivastava said, the matter has been taken into serious consideration. An investigation process has been initiated in this regard. Strict action will be taken against the culprit after the investigation is complete. Meanwhile, Prof. Amita Kanojia, Head of the Zoology Department, said - The audio has come to our attention. I have also heard it. The voice seems to be that of the same professor. Exam Controller filed a complaint with the police Lucknow University's Chief Proctor Prof. Rakesh Dwivedi said- After the audio came to light, a complaint has been filed with Hasanganj police station on behalf of the Exam Controller to register an FIR against the accused Assistant Professor. Additionally, the Internal Complaint Committee constituted under the Vishakha Committee has also started an investigation. Action will be taken very soon in this matter.The Controller of Examinations stated in his complaint - Three audio recordings of objectionable conversations between Dr. Paramjit Singh, Assistant Professor of Zoology Department, and a female student on the night of May 14 and 15, 2026, have been received.The professor made inappropriate proposals to the student and offered to leak two university exam papers for personal gain. This is a serious matter against the confidentiality of the examination and the dignity of the student. The pen drive containing the audio recordings has been submitted along with the complaint letter.News is being updated

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:SC stays Delhi HC order suspending ex-BJP MLA's life term in Unnao rape case; NEET-UG 2026 re-exam on 21 June more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from UP and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day- 1. NTA schedules NEET-UG 2026 re-exam for June 21 The National Testing Agency has officially scheduled the NEET-UG 2026 re-examination for Sunday, 21 June 2026. The exam held on 3 May 2026 was cancelled following paper leak allegations. The agency clarified that no fresh registration or additional fee will be required for the re-exam, and new admit cards will be issued. 2. SC sets aside BJP ex-MLA Kuldeep Sengar's sentence suspension in Unnao rape case, orders fresh HC hearing The Supreme Court on Friday quashed the Delhi High Court order suspending former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar’s life sentence in the 2017 Unnao rape case. The apex court directed the High Court to hear the matter afresh and deliver a fresh decision within two months. 3. Gorakhpur gets first robotic restaurant, ‘Robo Didi’ serves and greets guests Gorakhpur’s first robotic restaurant has opened near Nauka Vihar, where a robot named “Robo Didi” serves food and greets customers. Brought from Hyderabad, the robot wishes guests on birthdays and anniversaries and can work for nearly eight hours on a single charge before returning automatically to its station. 4. PM Modi concludes UAE visit, departs for Netherlands Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday concluded his visit to the United Arab Emirates and departed for the Netherlands as part of his five-nation tour. UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan personally saw off the Prime Minister at the airport, underlining the close ties between the two nations. 5. Mayawati asks Akhilesh to apologise to Brahmins over SP leader’s remarks BSP chief Mayawati on Friday demanded an apology from Akhilesh Yadav to the Brahmin community after controversial remarks by SP leader Rajkumar Bhati. She accused the Samajwadi Party of continuing caste-based politics and urged immediate action amid the growing row. 6. BJP Yuva Morcha leader shot in Lucknow, family alleges land mafia links BJP Yuva Morcha leader Chetan Tiwari was allegedly shot by Vaibhav Bajpai in Lucknow’s Mehendiganj area. The victim’s family accused the accused of land grabbing, running illegal settlements and operating a criminal network using political influence. Chetan remains under treatment in hospital. 7. 'India can play 'greater role' for peace in West Asia' Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said India can play a “greater role” in bringing peace to West Asia. Addressing a press conference here, he said there is no military solution to anything related to Iran. He also said Iran is ready to help pass all vessels through the Strait of Hormuz, adding that the situation in the Strait of Hormuz is very complicated now. 8. Eight get bail in Varanasi Ganga boat iftar case after 60 days Eight accused in the Varanasi Ganga boat iftar case were granted bail by the Allahabad High Court after spending 60 days in jail. Police had alleged the group hijacked a boat and organised an iftar gathering midstream on the Ganga. Bail pleas of six others will be heard on May 18. 9. Eleven of Gorakhpur family hospitalised after suspected food poisoning incident Eleven members of a family, including two children, were hospitalised in Gorakhpur after suffering vomiting, diarrhoea and breathing problems. Health officials suspect food poisoning after the family consumed watermelon and Maggi. A medical team will visit the village to investigate the exact cause of the illness. 10. Indian markets fall amid rising oil prices Indian stock markets reversed early gains and settled lower on Friday, 15 May 2026. The 30-share Sensex closed at 75,237.99 points, and the 50-share Nifty closed flat but in red at 23,643.50 points. Oil Marketing Company (OMC) stocks opened under pressure after the government of India increased petrol diesel prices by ₹3 per litre each.

stories.title: 8 accused get bail in Varanasi Ganga boat iftar case:Spent 60 days in jail, hearing for others on May 18
stories.summary: Eight accused arrested in the Varanasi Ganga boat iftar party case were granted bail after spending 60 days in jail. The bail plea of the remaining six accused will be heard in the Allahabad High Court on Monday, May 18. The division bench of Justice Rajiv Lochan Shukla and Justice Jitendra Kumar Sinha granted bail to the accused. The first bail petition was filed on behalf of Danish Saifi, Aamir Kaifi and Nurul Islam. Later, the remaining accused also moved separate petitions. The court heard the bail pleas of all 14 accused together. The case was registered on March 16 after BJP Yuva Morcha city president Rajat Jaiswal filed an FIR at Kotwali police station in Varanasi. Police arrested all 14 accused the same day. The accused were denied bail by the ACP court at Police Lines and were sent to jail. On April 28, police produced all the accused before the court. Police claim boatman was kidnapped and boat hijacked During an earlier hearing on April 28, police told the Allahabad High Court that the accused had allegedly kidnapped the boatman and hijacked the boat on March 15 before organising the iftar party in the middle of the Ganga river. According to police, the youths threatened the boatman and forced him to operate the boat. Police said the boatman tried to stop them during the party, but the group ignored him. Police also claimed that videos and photographs of the party were intentionally made to send a message beyond Varanasi. According to the prosecution, such an iftar gathering had never been organised in this manner on the Ganga in Kashi before. The videos allegedly showed visuals of a mosque, the Ganga river, arrangements on the boat and separate shots of chicken biryani. Police also told the court that the accused tried to project themselves as influential. Earlier, on April 17, the High Court had given the Uttar Pradesh government one week to file its counter affidavit. Video of iftar party triggered controversy The controversy began after videos of the iftar party surfaced on social media. The clips showed people having iftar on a boat in the middle of the Ganga river. Young men were seen consuming fruits, soft drinks and food during the gathering. According to the FIR, chicken biryani was also served along with fruits and dry fruits. After the videos circulated online, Hindu organisations and BJP workers objected to the event. Following the complaint filed by Rajat Jaiswal, police arrested 14 people within eight hours. All accused belong to Madanpura area Police said all 14 accused are residents of the Tadtalla area in Madanpura, Varanasi, and belong to the same extended family. Several of them are associated with a family locally known as “Babu Bidi Wale”. Those named in the case include Mohammad Awwal, Mohammad Sameer, Mohammad Ahmed, Noor Islam, Mohammad Faizan, Azad Ali, Mohammad Tahaseem, Mahfooz Alam, Nehal Afridi, Mohammad Tausif, Aamir Kaifi, Mohammad Anas and Danish Saifi. Police said all the accused are between 19 and 25 years old.

stories.title: Engineer posts final video before suicide in Gorakhpur:Family alleges dowry case pressure affected career mental health
stories.summary: A 33-year-old engineer from Uttar Pradesh allegedly died by suicide in Gorakhpur after recording an emotional final video in which he blamed prolonged marital disputes and harassment by his wife for pushing him towards death. The body of Pradumn Yadav, a resident of Kushinagar, was found hanging from a tree near Budhiya Mai temple inside Kusumhi forest on Thursday. Before taking the extreme step, he visited the temple and recorded a 1-minute-48-second video showing the noose tied to the tree. Final video raises disturbing questions In the video, Pradumn appeared emotionally broken and repeatedly spoke about the mental stress he had been facing for years. He said he no longer wished to live because of the suffering caused by his wife. He also appealed to people not to call his death untimely and admitted that thoughts of suicide had occupied his mind for the past one-and-a-half months. Key points from the video: Yadav was working with a private company in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. He had married Arpita Yadav on June 2, 2017. The couple had a five-year-old daughter. According to family members, the relationship turned bitter within months of marriage and disputes had continued for nearly six years. His brother Raghavendra alleged that after marriage, Arpita stayed briefly at her in-laws’ house before moving back to her maternal home. Later, when Pradumn took her to Delhi where he was employed at the time, the relationship worsened further. Family claims legal cases increased pressure The family alleged that after returning to her maternal home, Arpita filed dowry harassment and maintenance cases against Pradumn. Hearings in the matter had been continuing for several years. According to relatives: Temple visit before final step After attending the hearing, Pradumn reportedly visited his brother-in-law’s house in Hata and later travelled towards Gorakhpur to catch a train. On the way, he stopped at Budhiya Mai temple located deep inside Kusumhi forest, around 12 kilometres from Gorakhpur city. Police said he tied a towel to a tree near the temple, recorded the video and uploaded it as his WhatsApp status before hanging himself. A villager later spotted the body and alerted the police, who identified him through his mobile phone and identity documents. Family left devastated after death The engineer’s death has left the family shattered. His elderly parents, Umapati Yadav and Kalawati Devi, were inconsolable after receiving the news. Relatives said Pradumn had been under severe emotional and legal stress for years and struggled to balance court proceedings with his professional responsibilities. Police have begun an investigation and are examining the video and other digital evidence linked to the case.

stories.title: From childhood to final journey, Prateek's life in 25 photos:Married Aparna for love, enjoyed bodybuilding and flying planes
stories.summary: Prateek Yadav, the younger brother of Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, passed away at the age of 38. His last rites were held on May 14 at Bhaisakund in Lucknow, where several political leaders and family members gathered to pay their final respects. Among those present were Akhilesh Yadav, Shivpal Yadav, Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak and many other dignitaries. Prateek died on May 13, leaving his family and close friends in shock. Prateek and Aparna Yadav first met at a friend’s birthday party in 2001. At that time, Aparna was not aware that Prateek was the son of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Mulayam Singh Yadav. After their first meeting, the two stayed in touch and Prateek asked for Aparna’s email address. Their friendship later turned into a relationship, and they dated for nearly 11 years. In December 2011, Prateek and Aparna got married in a grand ceremony in Saifai. Several well-known personalities, including Amitabh Bachchan, attended the wedding. The couple later welcomed their daughter, Prathama. While Prateek focused on his gym and business activities, Aparna entered politics and eventually joined the BJP. See Prateek's journey from childhood to his last rites in 25 pictures Childhood - Fond of playing cricket, Grandma's darling Prateek Yadav was fond of cricket. Prateek Yadav's picture with a bat with his father, Mulayam Singh Yadav. (File photo) Youth - Started bodybuilding, became an animal lover This picture of Prateek Yadav is from the year 2017. At that time, he was 29 years old. (File photo) Marriage - Met Aparna at a birthday party, had a love marriage Amitabh Bachchan and Anil Ambani attended Prateek's wedding. (File photo) Married Life - Father of two daughters Hobby - Fond of luxury cars and flying planes Demise and Last Journey - Death by heart attack, father-in-law lit the pyre Prateek's picture with dogs and a monkey was placed on the hearse.

stories.title: Special camps for smart meter consumers begin in Lucknow:Complaints, bill correction and new connection services till May 30
stories.summary: The capital city of Lucknow has launched a special campaign to resolve complaints of smart meter consumers. The drive is being conducted by Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (MVVNL). Under the campaign, special camps will be organised at electricity sub-stations across the city from May 15 to May 30, 2026. Consumers can visit sub-stations in Amausi, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow Central and Jankipuram zones to get their complaints resolved. The camps will remain open from 10 am to 5 pm. Officials said reports of all complaints received during the campaign will also be prepared. The campaign is being carried out under the RDSS scheme on the directions of Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited to resolve issues related to prepaid smart meters. Consumers asked to bring relevant documents Director (Commerce) Rajat Juneja said consumers should carry all necessary documents related to their complaints while visiting the camps. stories.title: 11 family members hospitalised in Gorakhpur:Vomiting, diarrhoea reported, food poisoning likely; team to investigate village
stories.summary: A total of 11 members of a single family have been admitted to the district hospital in Gorakhpur after complaining of vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Family members said that all of them had eaten watermelon at night, followed by Maggi. The incident took place in the Beliapar police station area. On Thursday morning, neighbours first took the affected people to a Community Health Centre (CHC), and later they were admitted to the district hospital in the afternoon. A 2-year-old girl is also among the patients. Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Dr Rajesh Jha said that, according to the initial information given by the family, the case appears to be food poisoning. However, to determine the exact cause, a medical team will be sent to the village on Friday. He added that the situation is currently under control. Full incident details Annu Pandey, daughter of Amarnath Pandey of Malav village in Beliapar area, said that on Wednesday evening a street vendor came selling watermelon, and the family purchased it. Around 8 pm, all family members ate the watermelon. About an hour later, Maggi was prepared at home on the children’s insistence. The Maggi was eaten by Amarnath Pandey (65), his brother Baijnath Pandey (68), mother Shail Kumari (63), brother Anshu Pandey (26), and sister Purnima Pandey (25). In addition, Balram Pandey’s son Vedant (3) and Hunnu (2), Lakshmikant Pandey’s daughter Neha, relative Jagdish Dubey (80), and Saurabh Tripathi (25) also consumed watermelon and Maggi. Around 1 am, one after another, everyone began falling ill. deteriorating. Condition worsened, local unqualified doctor treatment ineffective According to the family, around 1 am children first started vomiting, followed by diarrhoea. Soon, elders in the house also developed stomach pain, vomiting and diarrhoea. They also began experiencing breathing difficulties. As the condition worsened, the family consulted a local unqualified practitioner in the village and took some medicines, but there was no improvement. As the condition kept deteriorating, by morning neighbours arranged for them to be taken to the local CHC. After initial treatment there, doctors referred them to the district hospital. All 11 patients were admitted to the emergency ward, where treatment was started. Dr RP Gautam said that all 11 patients from the same family have been admitted and are out of danger. They are being monitored and will be discharged once their condition improves. CMO checked on the patients' condition CMO Dr Rajesh Jha also visited the hospital and met the patients. He took details from the family and discussed the situation with doctors. He said the patients are stable and the case appears to be food poisoning. He added that a medical team will visit the village on Friday to investigate the matter further. The CMO also said that consuming cold food items followed by hot food can sometimes lead to bacterial infection in the stomach, which can cause illness.

stories.title: Mayawati demands Akhilesh Yadav apologise to Brahmin community:Urges immediate action amid caste row controversy
stories.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has strongly reacted after Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Rajkumar Bhati made controversial remarks on the Brahmin community. Posting on X on Friday, she termed the SP spokesperson’s statement as irresponsible and urged SP chief Akhilesh Yadav to take immediate cognisance of the matter, apologise to the Brahmin community and express regret. She further said that the SP’s caste-based mindset and politics had not changed, rather it had deepened further. According to her, the statement has deeply hurt the self-respect of the entire Brahmin community. Controversial video triggers backlash and apology The controversy began after a video of Rajkumar Bhati surfaced two days ago in which he was heard quoting a saying that Brahmins and sex workers were being compared in a derogatory manner. The remarks sparked anger from the World Brahmin Federation and members of the community. Following the backlash, Bhati later issued a video apology. Watch Rajkumar Bhati's VIDEO Now know what Mayawati said on this 1- 'SP which does casteist politics is silent, this is escalating the matter' Mayawati said an SP national spokesperson had recently made indecent and objectionable remarks about the Brahmin community, leading to widespread outrage. She noted that despite a police case being registered, the issue continues to escalate. She added that the SP leadership’s silence on what she called caste-based politics is worsening the situation and increasing tension. 2- The self-respect of the Brahmin community was hurt by the SP spokesperson's statement The former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister said the irresponsible statement had hurt the dignity and self-respect of the Brahmin community. She stressed that SP leadership must take immediate action and apologise to the community. 3- ‘In BSP there is no "use and throw", but the welfare of all communities is protected’ Mayawati also took a swipe at the Uttar Pradesh government, saying that there is visible resentment in the Brahmin community regarding its approach, which is not hidden from anyone. She added that BSP has always ensured respect and participation for all communities, including Brahmins, and highlighted that unlike others, BSP follows a policy of inclusion rather than “use and throw”. Read what people said about Rajkumar Bhati's statement SP leader defends himself, issues clarification apology After the controversy escalated, Rajkumar Bhati posted a video on X apologising and said that if his words hurt the sentiments of the Brahmin community, he deeply regrets it. He said he follows socialist ideology and would never support discrimination against any caste or religion. He also alleged that BJP and its IT cell were running a campaign against him. Bhati added that he respects the Brahmin community, which has produced scholars, warriors, and intellectuals. Bhati explains context of his remarks Bhati clarified that the remarks were made during a literary discussion event held at Jawahar Bhawan in Delhi on May 5. He said the discussion was based on caste and communal issues, with several intellectuals participating. He said he referred to commonly used derogatory sayings that exist across communities and mentioned that such expressions exist on both sides. He claimed he did not endorse the offensive couplet and had even said it was inappropriate and should not be used. He added that selective clips of his speech were being used to target him, and people should watch the full video to understand the context.

stories.title: SC quashes Delhi HC order suspending Sengar’s sentence:Remits Unnao rape case to High Court for fresh decision
stories.summary: The Supreme Court of India on Friday set aside a Delhi High Court order that had suspended the life sentence of former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the 2017 Unnao rape case. A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi directed the Delhi High Court to hear the matter again and deliver a fresh decision within two months, without being influenced by the Supreme Court’s observations. The top court also asked the High Court to hear Sengar’s appeal and decide the criminal case as quickly as possible. During the hearing, the Supreme Court said the High Court’s earlier order was “partially correct and partially incorrect” and observed that several issues needed closer examination. The Supreme Court had earlier stayed the Delhi High Court order after the Central Bureau of Investigation challenged the decision. | High Court refuses to stay Kuldeep Sengar’s sentence Sengar serving life sentence in 2017 Unnao rape case Sengar is serving a life sentence after being convicted in the 2017 Unnao rape case involving a minor girl. The case had triggered nationwide outrage and intense political controversy. The survivor accused Sengar of raping her at his residence in Unnao after allegedly promising to help her get a job. The case drew national attention after the survivor and her family repeatedly accused police of inaction and alleged intimidation by Sengar’s associates. Public anger increased in 2018 when the survivor attempted self-immolation outside the residence of Yogi Adityanath in Lucknow, claiming no action had been taken against the powerful politician. The controversy deepened after the survivor’s father died in judicial custody under suspicious circumstances following his arrest in a case allegedly linked to Sengar’s aides. Supreme Court moved trial to Delhi over fairness concerns In 2019, the Supreme Court transferred all cases linked to the matter from Uttar Pradesh to Delhi, citing concerns over fairness and witness safety. The same year, the survivor and her lawyer were seriously injured in a suspicious road accident in Rae Bareli, while two of her relatives were killed. The incident led to allegations of a conspiracy to eliminate the survivor and brought even greater national attention to the case. In December 2019, a Delhi court convicted Sengar under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced him to life imprisonment. The court also imposed a fine and ordered compensation for the survivor. Over the years, the case has become one of India’s most politically sensitive criminal cases, raising questions about political influence, protection for sexual assault survivors and the criminal justice system.

stories.title: Ranbir Kapoor buys ₹3.31 crore land in Ayodhya:Joins Amitabh Bachchan in investing in 'The Saryu' project, to play Lord Ram in 'Ramayana'
stories.summary: Actor Ranbir Kapoor has bought land in Ayodhya's real estate project 'The Saryu'. This project is a premium plotted development project by ‘The House of Abhinandan Lodha’ (HoABL). News agency ANI reported that, according to the company's official announcement, the deal was made for ₹3.31 crore. The total area of the purchased land is 2,134 square feet. After Amitabh Bachchan, Ranbir Kapoor has become the second renowned actor to invest in 'The Saryu'. 'The Saryu' is a 75-acre project located on the banks of the Saryu River. The project includes a grand clubhouse, more than 35 lifestyle amenities, and a five-acre pure vegetarian luxury hotel by The Leela Hotels. ‘Ayodhya chose me’: Ranbir Ranbir said in a statement that he feels Ayodhya has chosen him. He said that Ayodhya is an important part of India's history and cultural heritage, and this land in 'The Sarayu' will become a part of his family's legacy. Abhinandan Lodha, Chairman of HoABL, said that Ayodhya is undergoing a period of cultural and economic renaissance. He said that due to infrastructure, tourism, and attracting global attention, the city has long-term development potential. He said that Ranbir Kapoor's investment shows that buyers are looking at Ayodhya not only emotionally but also from a future perspective as an important investment destination. Ranbir to play Lord Ram in 'Ramayana' Notably, this investment has come at a time when Ranbir is playing the role of Lord Shri Ram in director Nitesh Tiwari's film 'Ramayana'. On the occasion of Hanuman Jayanti, Ranbir's look as Lord Ram from the film was also revealed. See a glimpse of Lord Ram's look- In the video, Ranbir Kapoor was also seen wielding a bow as Lord Ram. stories.title: Lucknow man kills wife over suspected affair:Body stuffed in trolley bag, later held at police station after filing missing complaint
stories.summary: A man in Lucknow allegedly killed his wife over suspicion of an affair and dumped her body in a trolley bag near Indira Dam. He later went to the police station and reported her missing. However, repeated changes in his statement raised suspicion, following which police arrested him. During strict interrogation, he confessed to the murder. Acting on his statement, police recovered the body, sent it for post-mortem, and took the accused into custody. The incident took place in Chinhat. The deceased has been identified as 24-year-old Yasmin, wife of Altaf alias Kallu. Dispute occurred at night, murder committed at dawn Yasmin, daughter of vegetable trader Mohammad Shaheed, had been married to Altaf alias Kallu, a resident of Chinhat, for six years. The couple has a daughter and a son. On 14 May around 8 am, Altaf reached Chinhat police station and informed police that his wife was missing. When police questioned him, he kept changing his statements, which raised suspicion. During interrogation, he said he suspected that Yasmin was having an affair with a close relative, which often led to disputes between them. He said that on the night of 13 May, they again had an argument over the same issue. Early on 14 May around 4 am, he strangled Yasmin to death. Loaded the bag containing the body onto an e-rickshaw and took it to Indira Dam Altaf told police that about an hour after the murder, he packed the body in a trolley bag and brought it to Chinhat market. He then booked an e-rickshaw and went to Indira Dam. After reaching there, he got off the e-rickshaw, carried the bag to the banks of the dam, and dumped it in the bushes. He then returned home and informed his family that Yasmin was missing. On their advice, he went to the police station to file a missing complaint. Police recovered the body stuffed in the bag After Altaf confessed to the crime, police took him into custody and reached the Indira Dam area based on his disclosure. The body was recovered from the location he had mentioned. Police have sent the body for post-mortem and are continuing further investigation.

stories.title: BJP Yuva Morcha leader shot in Lucknow:Family alleges land grab, illegal settlement, criminal network behind attack
stories.summary: The family of accused Vaibhav Bajpai, who shot BJP Yuva Morcha Lucknow metropolitan executive member Chetan Tiwari, is alleged to be highly influential and feared in the area. Locals claim the family maintains dominance in the region and is often involved in such incidents to assert control. It is alleged that the accused have encroached upon the land of Yogeshwar Rishikul Girls Inter College located in Mehendiganj and developed an illegal settlement there. Chetan’s brother has further alleged that people hired on rent are being forced into illegal and immoral activities. He claims no action is taken due to the influence of powerful connections. An illegal parking area has also been set up on the same land, for which monthly rent is being collected. First understand the entire matter Chetan Tiwari, son of Suresh Chand Tiwari, a resident of Mehendiganj and member of the BJP Yuva Morcha Lucknow metropolitan working committee, was constructing a parking area outside his house between 9 pm and 10 pm on April 9. At that time, Vaibhav Bajpai alias Kaustubh Bajpai, a resident of the same locality, arrived on foot carrying a pistol. Before anyone could understand what was happening, Vaibhav opened fire on Chetan. Chetan was hit and fell on the road. When his associate Udayraj Rawat rushed to save him, Vaibhav also fired at him, but he was not hit. After hearing the commotion, people gathered at the spot and the accused fled. Chetan is still under treatment in hospital. Now read about the dark deeds of the accused... Settlement Established by Occupying School Land Chetan Tiwari’s elder brother Rajneesh Tiwari alleged that in Mehendiganj, the land of Yogeshwar Rishikul Girls Inter College, where Jaipuria School is also located, has been partially encroached by Vaibhav. He further alleged that Bangladeshi and Rohingya individuals have been settled there. He claimed that such activities are routinely carried out and that those residing there are involved in illegal activities. He also alleged illegal charging for e-rickshaw battery charging facilities. He further said that due to political influence, no action has been taken. He alleged that encroachment and land grabbing are a habitual practice of the accused. He further claimed that if an elderly woman is living alone in a house, they approach her and later take possession of the property through killing or other means. Occupied the land given on lease Rajneesh Tiwari stated that in 1972, during the tenure of Chief Minister Kamalapati Tripathi, Shri Yogeshwar Rishikul Inter College and Yogeshwar Rishikul Girls Inter College were operating in the area. The management had sought land from the government for running schools. For the education of children, the government allotted 22 bigha land in Rajajipuram to Shri Yogeshwar Rishikul Inter College in 1976 on lease for running the institution. He said the government imposed conditions that the land could neither be used for any other purpose, nor sold, gifted, or transferred. Allegation - Vaibhav engages in hooliganism with the support of his contractor father The victim’s family alleged that Vaibhav’s father Santosh Kumar Bajpei works as a contractor with the Municipal Corporation. Vaibhav also assisted him in contracting work and allegedly used that influence to establish dominance in the area through intimidation and violence. The family said several complaints were made to police stations earlier, but no action was taken. During police questioning, Vaibhav allegedly admitted to old enmity with Chetan Tiwari and said he fired at him with the intention to kill due to a long-standing dispute. The accused and victim were friends until 3 years ago Vaibhav told police that till 2023, he and Chetan were close friends. He said his grandfather Puttan Bajpai was given the title of “Maharaj” by locals. Two years ago, Chetan Tiwari also started using “Maharaj” after his name, which led to a dispute between them. He said their friendship gradually turned into rivalry. In December 2024, Chetan filed a complaint against Vaibhav and his family, leading to two FIRs being registered. Other accused have not been arrested yet Chetan Tiwari’s wife has filed an FIR naming Vaibhav Bajpai, Harshit Bajpai and 4–5 unidentified persons under charges of attempt to murder and 10 other sections. One accused, Vaibhav, surrendered at the police station, while the remaining accused are still absconding. The victim’s family is demanding their arrest.

stories.title: CBI begins probe into Ansal land scam:Seeks original documents from LDA, questions land sale to Tulsiani
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has taken over the investigation into the high-profile Sushant Golf City land scam in Lucknow. The agency registered a case on April 8, 2026 against Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited and others, and has begun its probe. Following this, the agency has sought detailed information and original documents from the Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) on 13 key points. The CBI, two days ago, sent a letter to LDA Vice Chairman Prathamesh Kumar. It stated that investigation is being conducted under case number RC 219 2026 E 0008 under Sections 120-B and 420 of the IPC and the Prevention of Corruption Act. The agency has asked under what process and conditions the land was allotted to Ansal. Questions raised over land sale to Tulsiyani Builder The CBI has also sought clarification on under which rules or policies Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited transferred land meant for a group housing project to Tulsiani Construction and Developers Private Limited. Records related to NOC, permissions and licence amendments have also been demanded. Township Policy and Mortgaged Land Investigation The investigating agency has also asked for a copy of the township policy under which Ansal was granted a licence to develop the township. Details have also been sought regarding which land parcels were mortgaged for the project, what changes were later made in them, and whether any criminal case was registered in case of violations. The CBI has also asked for names, designations and contact details of officials who handled files related to the project. Notice Issued Under Section 91 The CBI has directed that all original documents be submitted at its headquarters in New Delhi. The agency has treated this as a notice under Section 91 of the Criminal Procedure Code and has asked for the matter to be treated as top priority. LDA Vice Chairman Prathamesh Kumar confirmed that the CBI had registered the case in April. Some documents have already been provided, while remaining records are being sent.
